introduction.zh: 你现在更愿意短时专注尝试、按情境调节、保留实际基础，还是打开不同联系？本版以古典火、水、土、风（气）为四个当代意象，提供20道普通、可调整的原创四选一。完成后比较原始次数，所有最高并列都完整显示；四份结果也可以先读。元素名不指身体成分，不按生日或星座计算，也不鉴定能力、健康、命运或职业。它与本站气质测试是不同题本，不能凭名字互相换算。
introduction.en: Would you currently prefer a brief focused attempt, adjustment to context, a practical base or varied connections? This edition uses classical Fire, Water, Earth and Air as four contemporary metaphors in 20 original, ordinary and adjustable choices. Compare raw counts after completion and read every highest-tied guide in full. All four guides can also be read first. Names describe no bodily composition and use no birthday or zodiac calculation. Ability, health, destiny and careers are not assessed. This is a different bank from our Temperament quiz, with no name-based conversion.

instructions.zh: 本版把火、水、土、风（气）作四种当代偏好意象：短时专注与尝试、按情境调整节奏、实际步骤与延续、开放与多种联系。它是20题原创四选一，不测身体能量、自然元素成分或真实能力，也不按生日和星座计算。每题选当前更愿意采用的普通做法，没有好坏或正确答案，所有情境都以自愿和可调整的范围为前提。20题全部选择后比较原始次数，所有最高并列完整保留；全选第一项会四种各5次。古典名称是背景，不证明本站题本经过心理验证，也不换算气质、DISC、MBTI或职业。
instructions.en: This edition uses Fire, Water, Earth and Air as contemporary preference metaphors: brief focus and an attempt, adjusting pace to context, tangible steps and continuity, or openness and varied connections. It is an original 20-question quiz, not a measure of bodily energy, elemental composition or ability, and uses no birthday or zodiac calculation. Choose the ordinary approach you currently prefer, without good–bad or correct answers. Situations assume voluntary participation within an adjustable scope. After all 20 choices, compare raw counts and retain every highest-tied full guide; choosing the first option throughout gives five each. Classical names provide context, not psychometric validation or conversion to Temperament, DISC, MBTI or career fit.

prompt.zh: 自选一段普通创作时间，你更想以哪种方式开始？
prompt.en: You choose a period for an ordinary creative activity. Which opening would you prefer?

label.zh: 抓住一个最想试的点，集中做一小段，按约定时点停下。
label.en: Take one appealing point and make a brief focused attempt with an agreed stopping time.

label.zh: 先看看当下材料和感受，再让做法逐步改变形状。
label.en: Notice the current materials and response, then let the approach change shape gradually.

label.zh: 准备容易重复的基础步骤，让这一次有清楚的依托。
label.en: Prepare simple repeatable steps that give this attempt a clear practical base.

label.zh: 留出多种开头，看看不同想法之间会出现什么联系。
label.en: Leave several openings available and explore connections among different ideas.

prompt.zh: 自己的一个普通安排有了变动，你更愿意怎样调整？
prompt.en: An ordinary arrangement of your own changes. How would you prefer to adjust?

label.zh: 按已经变化的条件重新调节节奏，不要求维持原来的形状。
label.en: Reshape the pace around changed conditions rather than preserve the original form.

label.zh: 先留下仍然合用的基础安排，让调整有个稳定起点。
label.en: Retain useful basic arrangements so the revision has a steady starting point.

label.zh: 把变动当作另看几种路径的机会，比较新的组合。
label.en: Use the change to consider several other routes and compare new combinations.

label.zh: 保留这次最想完成的一点，把短时间集中用在那里。
label.en: Keep the one part I most want to complete and concentrate a short period on it.

prompt.zh: 为自己调整一个小工作角落，你更想突出哪种体验？
prompt.en: You adjust a small work corner for yourself. Which experience would you prefer to emphasise?

label.zh: 常用东西有易取的位置，基本操作可以自然接续。
label.en: Accessible places for common objects so basic actions can continue simply.

label.zh: 有开放空间摆放几种想法，让不同材料容易发生联系。
label.en: Open space for several ideas and connections among different materials.

label.zh: 有一个明确的关注点，方便短时间投入一件事。
label.en: One clear focal point that supports a brief period devoted to a single activity.

label.zh: 物件和使用方式能随当下需要移动，不必固定不变。
label.en: Objects and uses that can move with current needs rather than remain fixed.

prompt.zh: 和愿意交流的朋友分享一个小点子，你更想怎样呈现？
prompt.en: You share a small idea with a friend who wants to discuss it. How would you prefer to present it?

label.zh: 把点子与几个相关想法放在一起，邀请不同角度。
label.en: Place the idea beside related possibilities and invite different perspectives.

label.zh: 先给一个简短鲜明的示例，让交流有一个具体开头。
label.en: Offer one brief vivid example that gives the conversation a concrete opening.

label.zh: 听对方明确说出的需要，调整自己讲述的节奏和范围。
label.en: Hear the needs they state and adjust the pace and scope of my explanation.

label.zh: 说明已经有的材料和步骤，让点子怎样使用容易看见。
label.en: Describe existing materials and steps so the possible use is easy to see.

prompt.zh: 一件普通小事只剩少量可用时间，你更愿意怎样安排？
prompt.en: Only a little time is available for an ordinary small task. Which arrangement would you prefer?

label.zh: 选一个边界清楚的小段，短时集中尝试后停下。
label.en: Choose a clearly bounded part for a short focused attempt, then stop.

label.zh: 随着实际进度调节计划，允许这次完成的形状不同。
label.en: Adjust the plan as progress becomes clear and allow a different shape of completion.

label.zh: 按简单步骤处理最基本的部分，保留可继续的位置。
label.en: Follow simple steps for the basic part and leave a clear place to continue.

label.zh: 快速看几种可行做法，保留最有启发的新联系。
label.en: Consider several workable approaches and keep a useful new connection.

prompt.zh: 接触一项自己选的新爱好，你更想享受哪种过程？
prompt.en: You explore a new hobby you chose. Which process would you most like to enjoy?

label.zh: 按自己的实际反应调整速度，让过程不必照既定模式。
label.en: Adjust speed to my actual response rather than follow a predetermined pattern.

label.zh: 反复熟悉一个基础动作，让下一次能接着进行。
label.en: Become familiar with one basic action so another attempt can build on it.

label.zh: 看看不同做法怎样相通，不急着固定自己只用一种。
label.en: Explore how different methods connect without settling on only one immediately.

label.zh: 为一个安全的小尝试投入短时间，体验开始的鲜明感。
label.en: Give a safe small attempt a short period and enjoy a distinctive start.

prompt.zh: 整理一小页个人照片记录，你更想先做哪件事？
prompt.en: You organise a small page of personal photo notes. What would you prefer to do first?

label.zh: 先放好日期和基本记录，让信息以后仍容易接续。
label.en: Set out dates and basic notes so the information remains easy to continue later.

label.zh: 把不同时刻并置，看看会不会形成意想不到的联系。
label.en: Place different moments together and look for unexpected connections.

label.zh: 挑一个最想呈现的瞬间，用它带出这页的重点。
label.en: Choose the moment I most want to present and make it the focus of the page.

label.zh: 按这次看照片时的感觉调整顺序，让页面自然展开。
label.en: Adjust the order to my present response and let the page develop gradually.

prompt.zh: 一个自愿小组邀请你提供一项贡献，你更想选哪一种？
prompt.en: A voluntary group invites one contribution from you. Which would you prefer?

label.zh: 提出几种不同想法，让大家看到原来没有连接的可能。
label.en: Offer varied ideas that reveal possibilities not previously connected.

label.zh: 为当前最有兴趣的一小部分做一次明确的短尝试。
label.en: Make one clear brief attempt at the part that interests me most now.

label.zh: 根据参与者已经说明的需要，帮助调整活动节奏。
label.en: Help adjust the pace around needs participants have actually expressed.

label.zh: 把普通基础事项安排得容易取用，方便活动接着进行。
label.en: Make basic practical arrangements accessible so the activity can continue simply.

prompt.zh: 自己的小作品收到一条具体反馈，你更想怎样回应？
prompt.en: You receive specific feedback on a small piece of your work. How would you prefer to respond?

label.zh: 选一处最想改的地方，马上安排一个短而集中的试改。
label.en: Pick one part I want to revise and arrange a brief concentrated trial.

label.zh: 先理解反馈针对的实际需要，再按情况调整作品。
label.en: Understand the practical need behind the feedback and reshape the piece accordingly.

label.zh: 核对哪些基础部分仍可用，只把需要改的步骤接好。
label.en: Check which basic parts remain useful and reconnect only the steps needing revision.

label.zh: 把反馈看作另一种视角，尝试一个以前没想到的关联。
label.en: Treat it as another viewpoint and try a connection I had not considered.

prompt.zh: 要整理一小批自己的日常笔记，你更喜欢哪种方式？
prompt.en: You organise a small set of everyday notes. Which approach would you prefer?

label.zh: 按笔记实际出现的内容调整分组，不强行塞进旧类别。
label.en: Adjust groups to the material that appears rather than force existing categories.

label.zh: 保留简明一致的入口，让以后添加和查找容易延续。
label.en: Keep a simple consistent entry point so adding and finding notes remains straightforward.

label.zh: 画出几个内容之间的联系，让检索不只靠一种分类。
label.en: Sketch links among topics so retrieval does not depend on a single classification.

label.zh: 选一个短时间段处理最想完成的一组，结束后就停。
label.en: Use a short period for the group I most want to finish, then stop.

prompt.zh: 一段自由晚间可以由自己选择，你更想保留什么？
prompt.en: You can choose how to spend part of an evening. What would you prefer to keep?

label.zh: 一个熟悉而可持续的小安排，让休息或活动容易接上。
label.en: A familiar manageable arrangement that lets rest or activity continue simply.

label.zh: 几个开放选项和一点变化空间，看看不同兴趣怎样连接。
label.en: Several open options and room for variation among different interests.

label.zh: 一件现在确实想投入的小事，短时集中而不排满。
label.en: One small activity I actually want to engage with briefly, without filling the evening.

label.zh: 随当时需要调整的余地，不必照事先定好的节奏。
label.en: Room to adjust to present needs rather than follow a pace fixed in advance.

prompt.zh: 为普通问候做一张小卡片，你更想强调什么？
prompt.en: You make a small card for an ordinary greeting. What would you prefer to emphasise?

label.zh: 组合两种有趣的表达，让熟悉的话出现新的联系。
label.en: Combine two interesting forms so a familiar message has a new connection.

label.zh: 一个简短而鲜明的重点，把自己想说的话集中呈现。
label.en: One brief distinctive focus that concentrates what I want to express.

label.zh: 按对方明确表达的喜好调整语气，不猜测隐藏心思。
label.en: Adjust the tone to preferences they have expressed rather than guess hidden thoughts.

label.zh: 简单清楚的文字与可用格式，让卡片容易阅读和保留。
label.en: Simple clear words and a usable format that is easy to read and keep.

prompt.zh: 一个低风险小尝试没有按预想进行，你更愿意接着做什么？
prompt.en: A low-stakes attempt differs from what you expected. What would you prefer next?

label.zh: 找一处仍想尝试的地方，给它一个有限的集中时段。
label.en: Choose one part I still want to attempt and give it a limited focused period.

label.zh: 重新看看现在需要什么，让下一步随实际情况改变。
label.en: Reconsider current needs and let the next step change with the situation.

label.zh: 回到仍然合用的基础条件，把可继续的部分留好。
label.en: Return to useful basic conditions and retain the parts that can continue.

label.zh: 换一个角度理解这次结果，比较另几种可行路线。
label.en: Understand the outcome from another angle and compare other workable routes.

prompt.zh: 普通说明中有一处不清楚，你更想先怎样处理？
prompt.en: One part of an ordinary instruction is unclear. How would you prefer to address it first?

label.zh: 问清当前实际使用的需要，再调整理解和操作方式。
label.en: Clarify present use needs and adjust my interpretation and approach.

label.zh: 核对已有的基础步骤，标出缺少哪一项具体信息。
label.en: Check the basic steps already given and identify the specific information missing.

label.zh: 比较另一种解释或示例，寻找能把两者连接的线索。
label.en: Compare another explanation or example and look for a connecting clue.

label.zh: 确认权限与安全后，用一个最小例子短时试一下。
label.en: After checking permission and safety, briefly try a minimal example.

prompt.zh: 给一个普通个人计划预留少量精力，你更想怎样使用？
prompt.en: You reserve a little effort for an ordinary personal plan. How would you prefer to use it?

label.zh: 让简单基础得到维护，给下一次留下可继续的位置。
label.en: Maintain simple basics and leave a workable place for another occasion.

label.zh: 为不同想法留一点试探空间，不急着选唯一答案。
label.en: Leave exploratory space for different ideas without choosing a single answer immediately.

label.zh: 集中给最想尝试的一小点，不要求长时间持续。
label.en: Concentrate it on one small attempt I want without requiring prolonged effort.

label.zh: 根据当下状态和实际条件调节，不预定完全相同的形状。
label.en: Adjust it to current response and conditions rather than prescribe an identical form.

prompt.zh: 新人自愿参加一项普通活动，你更想提供哪种开头？
prompt.en: Someone new voluntarily joins an ordinary activity. Which opening would you prefer to offer?

label.zh: 几种不同的参与想法，让对方也能提出新的组合。
label.en: Several participation ideas that leave room for another combination of their own.

label.zh: 一个短而明确的展示，说明这次可以先尝试什么。
label.en: A short clear demonstration of what can be tried first this time.

label.zh: 询问对方愿意怎样参与，再按说出的需要调整节奏。
label.en: Ask how they want to participate and adjust the pace to stated needs.

label.zh: 清楚可访问的基本说明，让对方知道东西在哪里、怎样继续。
label.en: Accessible basic information about where things are and how to continue.

prompt.zh: 自己写一小段文字时，你更想怎样推进？
prompt.en: When writing a short piece of your own, how would you prefer to proceed?

label.zh: 抓住一个最想表达的重点，短时间集中写出一段。
label.en: Hold one point I want to express and write a brief concentrated passage.

label.zh: 让文字随写下的感受改变，不要求照原来的形状。
label.en: Let the text change with my response rather than keep its original shape.

label.zh: 先搭一个简单可续的顺序，把基本意思放清楚。
label.en: Build a simple sequence that can continue and state the basic meaning clearly.

label.zh: 把几个不同想法放在一起，看看能出现什么新联系。
label.en: Bring different ideas together and explore the new connections that appear.

prompt.zh: 一次普通自选活动将结束，你更想先处理什么？
prompt.en: An ordinary activity you chose is ending. What would you prefer to attend to first?

label.zh: 按当下需要调整收尾，不为了形式保留所有原步骤。
label.en: Adjust the ending to current needs rather than preserve every original step for form.

label.zh: 收好基础材料和必要记录，让之后容易重新接上。
label.en: Keep basic materials and necessary notes so another occasion can reconnect easily.

label.zh: 留下一个新的联系或问题，允许以后从不同角度再看。
label.en: Leave a new connection or question that can be revisited from another angle.

label.zh: 完成自己还愿意试的最后一小点，再明确停下。
label.en: Complete one final small part I still want to try, then explicitly stop.

prompt.zh: 回想一段普通经历，你更想记住哪种部分？
prompt.en: Looking back at an ordinary experience, which part would you most like to remember?

label.zh: 简单条件被好好保留，让事情可以延续的部分。
label.en: Simple conditions retained in a way that let the activity continue.

label.zh: 不同想法之间突然出现联系、让视角打开的部分。
label.en: A connection among different ideas that opened another view.

label.zh: 自己短时投入一个具体尝试、让事情开始的片刻。
label.en: A moment of brief involvement in a concrete attempt that got something started.

label.zh: 根据实际情境调节节奏，让过程变得适合的地方。
label.en: Where the pace changed with the situation and made the process fit better.

prompt.zh: 准备下一次普通小选择，你更想给自己哪种余地？
prompt.en: Preparing for another ordinary small choice, which room would you prefer to give yourself?

label.zh: 保留不同可能与新的联系，不急着固定一种路线。
label.en: Keep varied possibilities and new connections without fixing one route immediately.

label.zh: 选一个愿意短时投入的点，允许尝试后就结束。
label.en: Choose one point for brief involvement and allow the attempt to end afterwards.

label.zh: 随明确的需要重新调整，不必始终维持同一种节奏。
label.en: Readjust to stated needs without maintaining the same pace throughout.

label.zh: 沿用仍合适的基础安排，让下一步容易继续。
label.en: Reuse a basic arrangement that still fits and makes the next step straightforward.

headline.zh: 四种当代偏好意象之一，不是身体、性格或能力结论。

summary.zh: 把火读作一次有边界的集中尝试：有具体开头，也有停下和调整的空间；不判断能量、勇气、脾气或领导力。
summary.en: Read Fire as a bounded concentrated attempt, with a concrete opening and room to stop or adjust. It certifies neither energy, courage nor leadership.

scoreReading.zh: 20题全部各选一项，对应主题加1，总数固定20。四主题每题均提供，全卷各出现20次、每个位置5次。原始次数是本组可选做法中的相对分布，不是身体元素比例、相似度百分比、品质强弱或人口排名。所有最高计数都保留完整结果；全选第一项会四种各5次，四份完整显示。名单顺序不设主次，不自动指定第二元素；相差一次只是一项选择，不证明显著差异、某种品质消失或固定混合类型。近分可以比较，但不补造未并列的结论。情境和时间可能改变回答，没有常模、稀有度或科学分界。
scoreReading.en: Choose one option for all 20 questions; each adds one to its theme and counts always sum to 20. All four themes appear in every question, 20 times each and five times in each position. Raw counts describe relative choices among these approaches, not bodily element proportions, similarity percentages, quality levels or population ranks. Every highest count retains its full guide. Choosing the first option throughout gives five each and displays all four. List order establishes no priority or automatic secondary element. A one-choice gap proves neither significance, absent qualities nor a fixed mixed type. Compare close counts without inventing untied conclusions. Context and time may change answers. There are no norms, rarity estimates or scientific cutoffs.

title.zh: 火元素测试结果：专注尝试、例子与完整说明
title.en: Fire Element Result: Focus, Examples and Full Guide

description.zh: 把火读作一次有边界的集中尝试：有具体开头，也有停下和调整的空间；不判断能量、勇气、脾气或领导力。
description.en: Explore Fire through a brief focused attempt, a practical example and comparisons. Read the full guide without claims about energy, courage or leadership.

title.en: Classical context and this edition’s metaphor

paragraphs.zh: 本版把火用作“短时专注与尝试”的当代意象：愿意给一个现在在意的小点，留一段边界清楚的投入。它不要求一直热烈、迅速或有激情；短暂尝试后停下也符合这个选择。古典元素名只是符号背景，不是身体成分、气质类型或心理能力的测量。
paragraphs.en: Fire labels brief focus and an attempt in this edition: giving one point that matters now a clearly bounded period of involvement. It requires no permanent intensity, speed or passion. Stopping after a short attempt can fit the preference too. A classical name supplies symbolic context rather than a measure of bodily composition, temperament type or psychological capability.

title.en: Reading counts in context

paragraphs.zh: 若次数最高，本次较常选择抓一个重点、先试一小段，或把有限时间集中用在愿意做的部分。可以问：我真正想试什么，愿意给多少时间，怎样知道这次够了？较少选择可能因为需要更多条件、休息或不同节奏，不说明不积极、不果断或没有勇气。
paragraphs.en: A highest count means you more often chose a focal point, a brief attempt or concentrating limited time on a willing contribution. What do you actually want to try, for how long, and how will you know it is enough? Fewer choices may reflect conditions, rest or another pace rather than low initiative, indecision or absent courage.

title.en: An ordinary everyday example

It concerns neither breathing, bodily energy nor elemental composition, and requires no endless thinking, change or sociability. Openness is a currently preferred approach rather than a certificate of intelligence, originality, freedom or superior reasoning.

title.en: Reading counts in context

title.en: An ordinary everyday example

paragraphs.en: Air emphasises links among possibilities, Fire a focused attempt, Water response to context and Earth a continuing base. They can alternate: after opening routes, choosing, adjusting and retaining each have a place. A tie proves no collection of talents and cannot convert into Sanguine temperament, MBTI Intuition, DISC or a learning type. Workplace innovation cannot be inferred from these choices.

paragraphs.en: Keeping options may reflect missing information, unclear requests or inability to decide rather than preference; selecting one quickly can still be imaginative. Creativity, intelligence, attention, memory and neurological conditions are not measured. Counts provide no strength credential. answer.en: This is an independently authored FermatMind four-element preference metaphor quiz. Stanford’s Empedocles entry checks the classical background of Fire, Water, Earth and Air as four roots, without validating this questionnaire, mapping, counts or interpretation. All 20 items, options, contemporary themes, explanations, examples and rules are original. No JobCannon 12-item bank, competitor result text, code, algorithm or protected image is used. Ancient natural philosophy is neither modern chemistry nor psychology; historical Love and Strife supply no personal principles. This is not a birthday or zodiac calculation, bodily energy, five-element or Chinese medical framework, humoural doctrine, Avatar character quiz or scientific personality taxonomy. It converts into no Temperament, DISC, MBTI or career result and certifies no health, empathy, reliability, intelligence, creativity, morality, attractiveness or ability. It predicts no destiny and has no psychometric validation.
